title: Canonical carrier and degree-zero coordinates for point Tate fibres
statement: Fix the finite-field datum, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$; use the signed Tate lines, their actual point fibres, and the fixed coefficient/carrier lift and descent functors of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point], [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists], [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport], [def-weil-point-section-scalar-functors]. For every $m\in\mathbf Z$, define rationalSizeNormalization from the carrier lift of the rational point fibre of $E_s(m)$ to coefficient descent of the large rational fibre of its integral representative: compose the recorded pointRationalFibreObjIso, the inverse lift-down comparison, and the counit of the fixed pointFibreSizeLift equivalence. Define rawRationalSingle from the large rational fibre of the integral Tate line in degree zero to the single complex on scalar extension of its actual integral sections: first apply derived scalar extension to the integral sections/single comparison, then the scalar-extension/single comparison. All comparisons are those of the fixed exact functors; no arbitrary fibre isomorphism is chosen.
